<style>
/* =========================================================
   FINANCIAL ASSESSMENT REPORT
   ========================================================= */

@page {
    size: A4;
    margin: 14mm 13mm 16mm 13mm;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #1e2a3a;
    font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
    print-color-adjust: exact;
}

.page {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 265mm;
    position: relative;
    page-break-after: always;
    padding-bottom: 14mm;
}
.page:last-child { page-break-after: auto; }

/* =========================================================
   PAGE HEADER / TITLES
   ========================================================= */
.page-header {
    padding-bottom: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
}
.company-name {
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f2a4a; letter-spacing: 0.6px;
}
.report-title {
    font-size: 9.5px; color: #7b8a9c; margin-top: 2px; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}
.page-title {
    font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f2a4a;
    margin: 0 0 4px 0; letter-spacing: -0.3px;
}
.page-subtitle { color: #7b8a9c; font-size: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; }

/* =========================================================
   SECTION HEADINGS
   ========================================================= */
.section { margin-bottom: 16px; page-break-inside: avoid; }
.section-heading {
    color: #0f2a4a; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.7px; text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 10px; padding-bottom: 6px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #0f2a4a;
}
.section-heading.light {
    background: #f4f7fb; color: #0f2a4a; border-bottom: none;
    border-left: 4px solid #0f2a4a; padding: 8px 11px;
    margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* =========================================================
   KPI CARDS
   ========================================================= */
.cards {
    display: table; width: 100%; table-layout: fixed;
    border-spacing: 6px 0; margin: 0 -6px;
}
.card {
    display: table-cell; vertical-align: top;
    background: #f7f9fc; border: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
    border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 12px 11px 12px;
}
.card-gap { display: table-cell; width: 6px; }
.card-label {
    color: #7b8a9c; font-size: 8.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.7px; font-weight: 600;
}
.card-value {
    color: #0f2a4a; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700;
    margin-top: 5px; letter-spacing: -0.3px;
}
.card-value.green  { color: #1e7a4b; }
.card-value.red    { color: #b03030; }
.card-value.orange { color: #b07b1a; }
.card-status {
    display: inline-block; font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 700;
    margin-top: 6px; letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}
.card-status.good   { color: #1e7a4b; }
.card-status.watch  { color: #b07b1a; }
.card-status.action { color: #b03030; }

/* =========================================================
   TABLES
   ========================================================= */
.data-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 6px; }
.data-table th {
    background: #f4f7fb; color: #4a5b73; font-size: 8.5px;
    font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 9px; border: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
    text-align: left; letter-spacing: 0.4px; text-transform: uppercase;
}
.data-table td {
    padding: 8px 9px; border: 1px solid #edf1f6;
    vertical-align: middle; font-size: 9.5px; color: #1e2a3a;
}
.data-table tr { page-break-inside: avoid; }
.amount { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.center { text-align: center; }
.muted  { color: #7b8a9c; }
.small  { font-size: 8px; }

/* =========================================================
   BADGES
   ========================================================= */
.badge {
    display: inline-block; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700;
    padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 3px;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px; text-transform: uppercase;
}
.badge-good   { background: #e6f4ea; color: #1e7a4b; }
.badge-watch  { background: #fdf3e0; color: #a06a1a; }
.badge-action { background: #fde8e8; color: #a02020; }

/* =========================================================
   CHARTS
   ========================================================= */
.chart-box {
    border: 1px solid #e4e9f0; border-radius: 4px;
    background: #ffffff; padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 14px;
    page-break-inside: avoid;
}
.chart-title {
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f2a4a;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.hbar-chart { padding: 4px 0; }
.hbar-row {
    display: flex; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 9px; font-size: 9.5px;
}
.hbar-label { width: 140px; color: #1e2a3a; font-weight: 500; }
.hbar-track {
    flex: 1; background: #eef2f7; height: 14px;
    border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden;
}
.hbar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; background: #2e9e8f; }
.hbar-fill.watch { background: #e6a23c; }
.hbar-value { width: 40px; text-align: right; font-weight: 700; color: #0f2a4a; }

.bar-chart {
    height: 130px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: space-around; border-bottom: 1px solid #d4dce6;
    padding: 0 20px;
}
.bar-column {
    width: 22%; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center;
}
.bar {
    width: 42px; background: #3d7fa3;
    border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; min-height: 3px;
}
.bar-label {
    font-size: 8px; color: #4a5b73; margin-top: 7px;
    text-align: center; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}
.bar-value { font-size: 8.5px; color: #0f2a4a; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 5px; }

.donut-wrap { display: table; width: 100%; table-layout: fixed; }
.donut-cell { display: table-cell; width: 48%; vertical-align: middle; text-align: center; }
.legend-cell { display: table-cell; width: 52%; vertical-align: middle; padding-left: 8px; }
.donut { width: 145px; height: 145px; margin: auto; }
.legend-item { margin: 8px 0; font-size: 9.5px; color: #1e2a3a; line-height: 1.4; }
.legend-dot {
    display: inline-block; width: 11px; height: 11px;
    margin-right: 7px; vertical-align: middle; border-radius: 2px;
}
.dot-financial  { background: #2e9e8f; }
.dot-realestate { background: #e6a23c; }
.dot-business   { background: #f0c674; }
.dot-other      { background: #ef7d7d; }

/* =========================================================
   CALLOUTS
   ========================================================= */
.callout {
    border-left: 4px solid #0f2a4a; background: #f4f7fb;
    padding: 11px 14px; margin: 10px 0;
    border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; font-size: 9.5px; line-height: 1.55;
    page-break-inside: avoid;
}
.callout.warning { border-left-color: #e6a23c; background: #fdf7ec; }
.callout.danger  { border-left-color: #d9534f; background: #fdf1f1; }
.callout.success { border-left-color: #2e9e8f; background: #eef9f6; }
.callout-title {
    font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f2a4a;
    margin-bottom: 5px; letter-spacing: 0.4px; text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* =========================================================
   DISCLAIMER
   ========================================================= */
.disclaimer {
    border: 1px solid #e4e9f0; background: #fafbfd;
    padding: 13px 15px; font-size: 8.5px; line-height: 1.65;
    color: #4a5b73; border-radius: 4px;
}
.disclaimer ul { margin: 6px 0 0 0; padding-left: 18px; }
.disclaimer li { margin-bottom: 5px; }

/* =========================================================
   RETIREMENT CHART
   ========================================================= */
.retirement-chart-box {
    border: 1px solid #e4e9f0; border-radius: 4px;
    background: #ffffff; padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 14px;
    page-break-inside: avoid;
}
.retirement-chart-title {
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f2a4a;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px; margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.retirement-chart-legend {
    display: flex; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px;
    font-size: 9px; color: #4a5b73;
}
.retirement-chart-legend span {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.legend-line-solid {
    display: inline-block; width: 26px; height: 3px;
    background: #2e9e8f; border-radius: 2px;
}
.legend-line-dashed {
    display: inline-block; width: 26px; height: 0;
    border-top: 2px dashed #d9534f;
}
.retirement-chart-svg { width: 100%; height: 220px; }
</style>

{% set retirement_age = 60 %}

{% if years_to_retirement < 1 %}{% set years_to_retirement = 1 %}{% endif %}
{% if years_to_retirement > 45 %}{% set years_to_retirement = 30 %}{% endif %}

{% set projected_corpus = (
    financial_assets + (total_income * 0.3)
) * ((1.09) ** years_to_retirement) %}

{% set corpus_required = monthly_expenses * 12 * 25 %}

{% set retirement_readiness = (projected_corpus / corpus_required * 100) if corpus_required else 0 %}
{% if retirement_readiness > 100 %}{% set retirement_readiness = 100 %}{% endif %}
{% if current_age < 18 or current_age > 80 %}{% set retirement_readiness = 0 %}{% endif %}

{# Retirement chart data #}
{% set chart_ages = [] %}
{% set chart_projected = [] %}
{% set monthly_rate_chart = 0.09 / 12 %}
{% set start_corpus = financial_assets %}
{% set start_sip = monthly_surplus %}

{% for age_offset in range(0, years_to_retirement + 1) %}
    {% set months_elapsed = age_offset * 12 %}
    {% set fv_start = start_corpus * ((1 + monthly_rate_chart) ** months_elapsed) %}
    {% if monthly_rate_chart > 0 %}
        {% set fv_sip = start_sip * (
            ((1 + monthly_rate_chart) ** months_elapsed - 1) / monthly_rate_chart
        ) %}
    {% else %}
        {% set fv_sip = start_sip * months_elapsed %}
    {% endif %}
    {% set total = fv_start + fv_sip %}
    {% set _ = chart_ages.append(current_age + age_offset) %}
    {% set _ = chart_projected.append(total) %}
{% endfor %}

{% set chart_max = [
    (chart_projected | max if chart_projected else 0),
    corpus_required,
    1
] | max %}

                        stroke-dashoffset="-{{ financial_len }}" transform="rotate(-90 50 50)"></circle>
                    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42" fill="none" stroke="#f0c674" stroke-width="14"
                        stroke-dasharray="{{ business_len }} {{ circumference - business_len }}"
                        stroke-dashoffset="-{{ financial_len + realestate_len }}" transform="rotate(-90 50 50)"></circle>
                    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42" fill="none" stroke="#ef7d7d" stroke-width="14"
                        stroke-dasharray="{{ other_len }} {{ circumference - other_len }}"
                        stroke-dashoffset="-{{ financial_len + realestate_len + business_len }}" transform="rotate(-90 50 50)"></circle>
                </svg>
            </div>
            <div class="legend-cell">
                <div class="legend-item"><span class="legend-dot dot-financial"></span>Financial Assets ({{ "%.0f"|format(financial_pct) }}%)</div>
                <div class="legend-item"><span class="legend-dot dot-realestate"></span>Real Estate ({{ "%.0f"|format(realestate_pct) }}%)</div>
                <div class="legend-item"><span class="legend-dot dot-business"></span>Business Assets ({{ "%.0f"|format(business_pct) }}%)</div>
                <div class="legend-item"><span class="legend-dot dot-other"></span>Other Assets ({{ "%.0f"|format(other_pct) }}%)</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

</div>


<!-- =========================================================
     PAGE 4 — KEY RATIOS
     ========================================================= -->
<div class="page">

    <div class="page-title">Key Ratios and Benchmarks</div>
    <div class="page-subtitle">Financial health indicators and long-term planning</div>

    <table class="data-table">
        <thead>
            <tr>
                <th>Metric</th>
                <th class="amount">Your value</th>
                <th class="amount">Benchmark</th>
                <th class="center">Status</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
            <tr>
                <td>Savings rate</td>
                <td class="amount">{{ "%.1f"|format(savings_rate) }}%</td>
                <td class="amount">>= 20%</td>
                <td class="center">
                    <span class="badge {{ 'badge-good' if savings_rate >= 20 else 'badge-watch' }}">
                        {{ 'Good' if savings_rate >= 20 else 'Watch' }}
                    </span>
                </td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td>Emergency fund</td>
                <td class="amount">{{ "%.1f"|format(emergency_months) }} months</td>
                <td class="amount">>= 6 months</td>
                <td class="center">
                    <span class="badge {{ 'badge-good' if emergency_months >= 6 else 'badge-watch' }}">
                        {{ 'Good' if emergency_months >= 6 else 'Watch' }}
                    </span>
                </td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td>Debt-to-income (EMIs)</td>
                <td class="amount">{{ "%.1f"|format(debt_to_income) }}%</td>
                <td class="amount"><= 36%</td>
                <td class="center">
                    <span class="badge {{ 'badge-good' if debt_to_income <= 36 else 'badge-action' }}">
                        {{ 'Good' if debt_to_income <= 36 else 'Action' }}
                    </span>
                </td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td>Debt-to-assets</td>
                <td class="amount">{{ "%.1f"|format(debt_to_assets) }}%</td>
                <td class="amount"><= 40%</td>
                <td class="center">
                    <span class="badge {{ 'badge-good' if debt_to_assets <= 40 else 'badge-watch' }}">
                        {{ 'Good' if debt_to_assets <= 40 else 'Watch' }}
                    </span>
                </td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td>Largest asset class share</td>
                <td class="amount">{{ "%.0f"|format(largest_asset_share) }}%</td>
                <td class="amount"><= 60%</td>
                <td class="center">
                    <span class="badge {{ 'badge-good' if largest_asset_share <= 60 else 'badge-watch' }}">
                        {{ 'Good' if largest_asset_share <= 60 else 'Watch' }}
                    </span>
                </td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td>Retirement readiness</td>
                <td class="amount">{{ "%.0f"|format(retirement_readiness) }}%</td>
                <td class="amount">>= 100%</td>
                <td class="center">
                    <span class="badge {{ 'badge-good' if retirement_readiness >= 100 else 'badge-watch' }}">
                        {{ 'Good' if retirement_readiness >= 100 else 'Watch' }}
                    </span>
                </td>
            </tr>
        </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="section" style="margin-top: 20px;">
        <div class="section-heading">Protection and Insurance</div>
        <div style="font-size: 9px; color: #7b8a9c; margin-bottom: 8px; font-style: italic;">
            Life cover need = 10x annual income + outstanding debt − liquid and market investments (income-multiple method).
        </div>
        <table class="data-table">
            <thead>
                <tr>
                    <th>Cover</th>
                    <th class="amount">Current</th>
                    <th class="amount">Recommended</th>
                    <th class="amount">Gap</th>
                    <th class="center">Status</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
                <tr>
                    <td>Life cover</td>
                    <td class="amount">INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format(total_life_cover) }}</td>
                    <td class="amount">INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format(recommended_life_cover) }}</td>
                    <td class="amount">INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format(life_cover_gap) }}</td>
                    <td class="center">
                        <span class="badge {{ 'badge-good' if life_cover_gap <= 0 else 'badge-action' }}">
                            {{ 'Good' if life_cover_gap <= 0 else 'Action' }}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td>Health cover</td>
                    <td class="amount">INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format(total_health_cover) }}</td>
                    <td class="amount">INR 10,00,000</td>
                    <td class="amount">INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format([0, 1000000 - total_health_cover]|max) }}</td>
                    <td class="center">
                        <span class="badge {{ 'badge-good' if total_health_cover >= 1000000 else 'badge-action' }}">
                            {{ 'Good' if total_health_cover >= 1000000 else 'Action' }}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td>Disability / critical illness</td>
                    <td class="amount" colspan="3">Yes</td>
                    <td class="center"><span class="badge badge-good">Good</span></td>
                </tr>
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>

    <div class="section" style="margin-top: 20px;">
        <div class="section-heading">Retirement and Long-Term Planning</div>
        <table class="data-table">
            <tbody>
                <tr>
                    <td style="color:#7b8a9c; width:55%;">Current age / retirement age</td>
                    <td class="amount">{{ current_age }} / {{ retirement_age }} ({{ years_to_retirement }} years)</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td style="color:#7b8a9c;">Expected return / inflation</td>
                    <td class="amount">9.0% / 6.0%</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td style="color:#7b8a9c;">Monthly expense at retirement (today's value)</td>
                    <td class="amount">INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format(monthly_expenses) }}</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td style="color:#7b8a9c;">Monthly expense at retirement (future value)</td>
                    <td class="amount">
                        INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format(monthly_expenses * ((1.06) ** years_to_retirement)) }}
                    </td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td style="color:#7b8a9c;">Corpus required (4.0% withdrawal rate)</td>
                    <td class="amount">INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format(corpus_required) }}</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td style="color:#7b8a9c;">Current investable assets (market + retirement)</td>
                    <td class="amount">INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format(financial_assets) }}</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td style="color:#7b8a9c;">Monthly investment assumed</td>
                    <td class="amount">INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format(monthly_surplus) }}</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td style="color:#7b8a9c;">Projected corpus at retirement</td>
                    <td class="amount">INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format(projected_corpus) }}</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td style="color:#7b8a9c;">Shortfall</td>
                    <td class="amount">INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format([0, corpus_required - projected_corpus]|max) }}</td>
                </tr>
                <tr style="background:#f4f7fb; font-weight:700;">
                    <td>Extra monthly investment to close gap</td>
                    <td class="amount">
                        INR {{ "{:,.0f}".format([0, (corpus_required - projected_corpus) / (years_to_retirement * 12)]|max) }}
                    </td>
                </tr>
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>

</div>


<!-- =========================================================
     PAGE 5 — RECOMMENDATIONS
     ========================================================= -->
<div class="page">

    <div class="retirement-chart-box">
        <div class="retirement-chart-title">Retirement corpus: projected vs required</div>
        <div class="retirement-chart-legend">
            <span><i class="legend-line-solid"></i>Projected corpus</span>
            <span><i class="legend-line-dashed"></i>Required at {{ retirement_age }}</span>
        </div>

        {% set svg_width = 700 %}
        {% set svg_height = 220 %}
        {% set chart_padding_left = 80 %}
        {% set chart_padding_right = 40 %}
        {% set chart_padding_top = 20 %}
        {% set chart_padding_bottom = 40 %}
        {% set plot_width  = svg_width - chart_padding_left - chart_padding_right %}
        {% set plot_height = svg_height - chart_padding_top - chart_padding_bottom %}
        {% set total_points = chart_projected | length %}

        <svg class="retirement-chart-svg" viewBox="0 0 {{ svg_width }} {{ svg_height }}"
            preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

            {% for i in range(0, 5) %}
                {% set y_val = (chart_max / 4) * i %}
                {% set y_pos = svg_height - chart_padding_bottom - (plot_height * i / 4) %}
                <line x1="{{ chart_padding_left }}" y1="{{ y_pos }}"
                    x2="{{ svg_width - chart_padding_right }}" y2="{{ y_pos }}"
                    stroke="#eef2f7" stroke-width="1"/>
                <text x="{{ chart_padding_left - 8 }}" y="{{ y_pos + 3 }}"
                    text-anchor="end" font-size="9" fill="#7b8a9c">
                    {% if y_val >= 10000000 %}
                        {{ "%.1f"|format(y_val / 10000000) }} Cr
                    {% elif y_val >= 100000 %}
                        {{ "%.1f"|format(y_val / 100000) }} L
                    {% else %}
                        {{ "{:,.0f}".format(y_val) }}
                    {% endif %}
                </text>
            {% endfor %}

            {% if total_points > 1 %}
                {% for i in range(0, 5) %}
                    {% set idx = (total_points - 1) * i // 4 %}
                    {% set x_pos = chart_padding_left + (plot_width * i / 4) %}
                    <text x="{{ x_pos }}" y="{{ svg_height - chart_padding_bottom + 15 }}"
                        text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#7b8a9c">
                        {{ chart_ages[idx] }}
                    </text>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endif %}

            <line x1="{{ chart_padding_left }}"
                y1="{{ svg_height - chart_padding_bottom }}"
                x2="{{ svg_width - chart_padding_right }}"
                y2="{{ svg_height - chart_padding_bottom }}"
                stroke="#d4dce6" stroke-width="1"/>

            {% set required_y = svg_height - chart_padding_bottom - (corpus_required / chart_max * plot_height) %}
            <line x1="{{ chart_padding_left }}" y1="{{ required_y }}"
                x2="{{ svg_width - chart_padding_right }}" y2="{{ required_y }}"
                stroke="#d9534f" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>

            {% if total_points > 1 %}
                {% set points_str = "" %}
                {% for i in range(0, total_points) %}
                    {% set value = chart_projected[i] %}
                    {% set x_pos = chart_padding_left + (plot_width * i / (total_points - 1)) %}
                    {% set y_pos = svg_height - chart_padding_bottom - (value / chart_max * plot_height) %}
                    {% set points_str = points_str ~ x_pos ~ "," ~ y_pos %}
                    {% if i < total_points - 1 %}
                        {% set points_str = points_str ~ " " %}
                    {% endif %}
                {% endfor %}
                <polyline points="{{ points_str }}" fill="none" stroke="#2e9e8f"
                    stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            {% endif %}

            <text x="{{ chart_padding_left + plot_width / 2 }}"
                y="{{ svg_height - 5 }}" text-anchor="middle"
                font-size="9" fill="#7b8a9c">Age</text>
        </svg>
    </div>

    <div class="page-title">Recommendations</div>
    <div class="page-subtitle">Recommended actions based on the financial assessment</div>

    <table class="data-table">
        <thead>
            <tr>
                <th style="width:80px;">Priority</th>
                <th style="width:140px;">Area</th>
                <th>Recommended action</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>

            {% if advisory and advisory.key_observations_child %}
                {% for row in advisory.key_observations_child %}
                <tr>
                    <td class="center">
                        {% set p = (row.priority or "Medium")|lower %}
                        <span class="badge {{ 'badge-action' if p == 'high' else ('badge-watch' if p == 'medium' else 'badge-good') }}">
                            {{ row.priority or "Medium" }}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>{{ obs_key_map.get(row.observation_gap_recommendation) or row.observation_gap_recommendation or "-" }}</td>
                    <td>{{ row.proposed_action_solution or "-" }}</td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endif %}

            {% if advisory and advisory.insurance_recommendations_child %}
                {% for row in advisory.insurance_recommendations_child %}
                <tr>
                    <td class="center">
                        {% set p = (row.priority or "Medium")|lower %}
                        <span class="badge {{ 'badge-action' if p == 'high' else ('badge-watch' if p == 'medium' else 'badge-good') }}">
                            {{ row.priority or "Medium" }}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>{{ obs_insurance_map.get(row.observation_gap_recommendation) or row.observation_gap_recommendation or "-" }}</td>
                    <td>{{ row.proposed_action_solution or "-" }}</td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endif %}

            {% if advisory and advisory.investment_and_wealth_building_recommendations_child %}
                {% for row in advisory.investment_and_wealth_building_recommendations_child %}
                <tr>
                    <td class="center">
                        {% set p = (row.priority or "Medium")|lower %}
                        <span class="badge {{ 'badge-action' if p == 'high' else ('badge-watch' if p == 'medium' else 'badge-good') }}">
                            {{ row.priority or "Medium" }}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>{{ obs_investment_map.get(row.observation_gap_recommendation) or row.observation_gap_recommendation or "-" }}</td>
                    <td>{{ row.proposed_action_solution or "-" }}</td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endif %}

            {% if advisory and advisory.debt_management_recommendations_child %}
                {% for row in advisory.debt_management_recommendations_child %}
                <tr>
                    <td class="center">
                        {% set p = (row.priority or "Medium")|lower %}
                        <span class="badge {{ 'badge-action' if p == 'high' else ('badge-watch' if p == 'medium' else 'badge-good') }}">
                            {{ row.priority or "Medium" }}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>{{ obs_debt_map.get(row.observation_gap_recommendation) or row.observation_gap_recommendation or "-" }}</td>
                    <td>{{ row.proposed_action_solution or "-" }}</td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endif %}

            {% if advisory and advisory.tax_planning_recommendations_child %}
                {% for row in advisory.tax_planning_recommendations_child %}
                <tr>
                    <td class="center">
                        {% set p = (row.priority or "Medium")|lower %}
                        <span class="badge {{ 'badge-action' if p == 'high' else ('badge-watch' if p == 'medium' else 'badge-good') }}">
                            {{ row.priority or "Medium" }}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>{{ obs_tax_map.get(row.observation_gap_recommendation) or row.observation_gap_recommendation or "-" }}</td>
                    <td>{{ row.proposed_action_solution or "-" }}</td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endif %}

            {% if advisory and advisory.estate_succession_and_legal_planning_child %}
                {% for row in advisory.estate_succession_and_legal_planning_child %}
                <tr>
                    <td class="center">
                        {% set p = (row.priority or "Medium")|lower %}
                        <span class="badge {{ 'badge-action' if p == 'high' else ('badge-watch' if p == 'medium' else 'badge-good') }}">
                            {{ row.priority or "Medium" }}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>{{ obs_estate_map.get(row.observation_gap_recommendation) or row.observation_gap_recommendation or "-" }}</td>
                    <td>{{ row.proposed_action_solution or "-" }}</td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endif %}

            {% if advisory and advisory.goal_planning_implementation_recommendations_child %}
                {% for row in advisory.goal_planning_implementation_recommendations_child %}
                <tr>
                    <td class="center">
                        {% set p = (row.priority or "Medium")|lower %}
                        <span class="badge {{ 'badge-action' if p == 'high' else ('badge-watch' if p == 'medium' else 'badge-good') }}">
                            {{ row.priority or "Medium" }}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>{{ obs_goal_map.get(row.observation_gap_recommendation) or row.observation_gap_recommendation or "-" }}</td>
                    <td>{{ row.proposed_action_solution or "-" }}</td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endif %}

            {% if advisory and advisory.agreed_action_plan_immediate_next_steps_child %}
                {% for row in advisory.agreed_action_plan_immediate_next_steps_child %}
                <tr>
                    <td class="center">
                        {% set p = (row.priority or "Medium")|lower %}
                        <span class="badge {{ 'badge-action' if p == 'high' else ('badge-watch' if p == 'medium' else 'badge-good') }}">
                            {{ row.priority or "Medium" }}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>{{ row.category or "Action Plan" }}</td>
                    <td>{{ row.action_item or "-" }}</td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endif %}

        </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="section" style="margin-top: 22px;">
        <div class="section-heading">Assumptions and Disclaimer</div>
        <div class="disclaimer">
            <ul>
                <li>
                    Benchmarks: savings rate 20%, EMIs under 36% of income,
                    6-month emergency fund, health cover minimum INR 10,00,000.
                </li>
                <li>
                    Retirement projection uses 9.0% annual return, 6.0% inflation
                    and a 4.0% withdrawal rate; contributions are assumed at year end
                    and held flat.
                </li>
                <li>
                    Real estate and business equity are included in net worth
                    but excluded from the retirement corpus.
                </li>
                <li>
                    This report is generated from the information supplied and
                    from the assumptions listed above. It is for information and
                    planning purposes only and does not constitute investment,
                    tax or legal advice. Figures have not been audited. Please
                    consult a qualified financial adviser before acting on any recommendation.
                </li>
            </ul>
        </div>
    </div>

</div>
